fields.title: KNB (Kemitraan Negara Berkembang) Scholarship
fields.description: The KNB scholarship is a prestigious program funded by the Indonesian government for students from developing countries. It covers full tuition, living allowance, and accommodation.
fields.benefits:
Full tuition coverage
Monthly living allowance (IDR 2,500,000)
Accommodation provided
Return airfare
Book & research allowance
fields.requirements:
Bachelor degree with GPA 3.0+
Aged 25-35 years
Language certificate (TOEFL/IELTS or Indonesian language)
Health certificate
Recommendation letters

fields.title: UMM International Scholarship
fields.description: UMM offers partial and full scholarships for outstanding international students across all faculties. Strong academic record and motivation required.
fields.benefits:
50-100% tuition discount
Dormitory accommodation
Mentorship program
Language support
fields.requirements:
High school diploma
Minimum GPA 80/100
Motivation letter
Passport copy

fields.title: IIUM Merit Scholarship
fields.description: IIUM offers merit-based scholarships for Muslim international students pursuing postgraduate studies in various disciplines including Engineering, IT, and Business.
fields.benefits:
Full tuition waiver
Monthly stipend RM 1,000
Research funding up to RM 5,000
Health insurance
fields.requirements:
Bachelor with CGPA 3.5+
IELTS 6.0 or equivalent
Two academic references
Research proposal

fields.title: AIT Scholarship Thailand
fields.description: AIT provides scholarships for students from developing countries to pursue Master's programs in Engineering, Environment, and Management.
fields.benefits:
Full tuition coverage
Stipend USD 500/month
Research opportunities
Networking events
fields.requirements:
Bachelor degree (Engineering/Science)
GPA 3.0+
English proficiency
Work experience preferred
